_README: Gold-set rows removed by hand, with the reason stated per entry. `assemble.py`
reads this map and excludes these qids ahead of every other adjudication, so a
re-run reproduces the gold set as it stands rather than re-adding them.
This is deliberately not the same thing as a `drop` verdict. A drop says the
question is bad. These entries say the row could not be produced again: the
chunk it was drafted from is no longer in the eligible pool, so a clean re-run
of `generate.py` would never sample it and the row would not exist. Removing
them closes that reproducibility gap instead of documenting it.
Every entry here was checked: `drafted_from` is absent from the 392 chunks that
`select_eligible` currently returns. Rows the generation-time label check moved
onto an ineligible neighbour are NOT listed -- those were drafted from an
eligible chunk and a re-run reproduces them.
